name: OptiX Ray Generation & Traversal Setup
definition: The ray generation program that computes pixel rays, initializes the RNG, and dispatches volume tracing via OptiX `optixTrace`.
summary: OptiX Ray Generation & Traversal Setup computes pixel rays and dispatches volume tracing via optixTrace, distinguished by integrating OptiX 7 launch parameters, SBT indexing, and visibility masks to restrict traversal to volume geometry.
